$comment: Named corrections for misregistered USGS sheets, used by data/past/*/trace.json (decision 12; transit_pipeline.past). Each matches points the sheet draws (px on a crop of it) to the same points on a better sheet (true_px on a crop of that). Hand-read on Oct 14, 2026.

sf1915-bay.against: Yerba Buena Island on the 1949 Oakland West sheet
sf1915-bay.checks: For the bay shore of West Oakland and Emeryville. Checked two ways: the corrected Key Route Pier lines up with today's Key System ROW in Emeryville (same 15° bearing, its end about 45 m off), and the corrected Oakland Mole ferry terminal falls within about 20 m of the 1949 sheet's.
